cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Funnel Strategist & Copywriter role. I'm a digital marketer based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and my work sits where writing, SEO and web build overlap — which is also where funnels get built.

I write copy that ranks and pages that convert, then check the numbers. Freelance, I designed and built baverok.com myself: a hand-coded landing page with a free site-check enquiry flow, structured data and accessible markup. For mirook.com I wrote and implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical and GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. At Episto I handle keyword research, on-page SEO and SEO content for client websites, and publish and maintain WordPress pages across consultancy, e-commerce and association projects — including a consistent layout for roughly 600 member profile pages. Before that, at Knowledge Experts, I ran SEO analyses and reported on performance in Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

What attracts me to this role is the loop: research the audience, decide what to build and why, write it, then let real traffic tell you what's wrong. I use Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console daily, so data-driven iteration isn't new to me — it's how I already work. I'm also comfortable being told a draft missed, and would rather hear it early than ship something weak.

So far most of my funnel work has been organic: landing pages, offers, audits and content. I want to take that across the full funnel — email sequences, ads, sales assets and case studies — with performance data guiding each decision. I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium, and glad to work remotely.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss the role and walk you through my work at baverok.com.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
